name: Shenzhen Leaguer Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Leaguer Co., Ltd. engages in the design, manufacturing, and service provision of plastic packaging solutions for cosmetics, daily necessities, health products, and food in China and internationally. It designs, manufactures, and sells process equipment and precision molds; researches and develops polymer material modification and materials, as well as provides base platform, science and technology innovation operation, and investment incubation services.
